messages:
Emily (People Ops): @here Summer kickoff all-hands this Wednesday Jul 14 10:00 PT / 18:00 UTC. Please block the time. Agenda below — quick ask: drop 1-2 priority Qs in this thread or in the doc by EOD Tue. Slides + recording will be shared after the meeting. :calendar:

Agenda:
• 10m — Exec update (Mike)
• 15m — Product roadmap & priorities (Sanjay)
• 10m — Dedicated GA + infra notes (Jordan)
• 5m — People Ops update (Emily / Tom) — policy highlight
• 30m — Live Q&A (all)

Key notes: we'll call out the Dedicated GA date and initial pricing tiers, announce a small parental leave policy change (effective Aug 1), and share hiring priorities. If you want a customer or project mentioned, DM Lisa or Emily. RSVP with a :raised_hands:.

Mike (CEO): excited to share the progress on revenue + ops. will cover milestones and hiring plan. please surface any tough growth/scale questions here so we can prep answers.

Jordan - Eng: quick note — I'll demo the latency win from the new batching pipeline. infra folks pls join 5m early to confirm screen share. @Sanjay can you confirm the demo dataset?

Sanjay - Product: confirmed — I'll bring the eval slide and a short list of feature flags we plan to roll out. also asking product folks to post any regression concerns in the doc so we can address during Q&A.

Lisa - Sales: FYI we'll mention two recent enterprise closes. PMs, if you have a brief customer quote or single-slide highlight, drop it in the slide draft or DM me.

Tom - People Ops: parent leave/benefits update: we're piloting an extended parental leave stipend and flexible return options starting Aug 1. full policy doc here: https://handbook.internal/hr/parental-leave (please read before Wed if this affects your team).

Ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent to everyone. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 — recording will be posted to this channel and the handbook after the meeting.

Jordan - Eng: can the slides be uploaded by Tue 5pm? i want to run infra notes against the final deck.

Emily (People Ops): draft slides (work-in-progress): https://docs.internal/allhands/summer-kickoff-draft — feel free to add 1 slide or comment. final deck due Tue 5pm.

Mike (CEO): also plan to call out Q3 priorities and headcount plan at a high level. if anyone has questions about org moves, drop them here anonymously or bring to office hours.

Lisa - Sales: Will there be a separate sales/enterprise breakout after the all-hands? :thumbsup:

Sanjay - Product: Yes — we’ll run office hours Thu 11am PT for deep-dive product/roadmap questions.

Tom - People Ops: Thanks everyone. Quick housekeeping: please mute mic unless speaking and use the Q&A function or this thread for live questions.

Emily (People Ops): Thanks — see you Wednesday. I've pinned the agenda and the doc in this thread. If you can't attend, we'll post the recording + condensed notes within 24 hours. 

Lisa - Sales: noted, will add the customer quote slide.

Jordan - Eng: added infra note to slide doc.

Mike (CEO): cool — thanks team. looking forward.

Tom - People Ops: :thumbsup:
